raw_title: Adapt or Give Up: How Ukrainian Newsrooms Responded to the Termination of USAID Media Development Aid
title_en: Adapt or Give Up: How Ukrainian Newsrooms Responded to the Termination of USAID Media Development Aid
title_zh: Adapt or Give Up: How Ukrainian Newsrooms Responded to the Termination of USAID Media Development Aid
plain_summary_en: This paper studies Adapt or Give Up: How Ukrainian Newsrooms Responded to the Termination of USAID Media Development Aid. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Development aid, Ukrainian, Humanitarian aid, International development. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
